title: UrgencyLevel
description: Canonical ordered list of urgency levels. Order is significance-ordered from most to least urgent, EXCEPT INSUFFICIENT_INFO which is a non-comparable sentinel. `rank` drives the escalate-only merge in the triage engine (higher rank = more urgent).

levels.label: Doctor soon
levels.advice: See a doctor within a few days.

levels.label: Insufficient info
levels.advice: Not enough information to assess. Add symptoms or vitals.
